newsitem.title: CHINA: China's retail sales seen at 218 BLN yuan in June.
newsitem.headline: China's retail sales seen at 218 BLN yuan in June.

text.p: China retail sales of consumer goods are expected to reach 218 billion yuan ($26.27 billion) in June, up 12 percent compared with the year-ago period, the Financial News said on Friday.
China's retail sales of consumer goods were estimated to reach 1,302.16 billion yuan for the first half of the year, up 14.1 percent from the same period in 1996, it said.

Of the total, retail sales in urban areas would be worth 799.54 billion yuan in the first half, up 14.8 percent compared with the same period last year, while in rural areas sales would top 502.62 billion yuan, up 13.1 percent, the newspaper said.
Officials figures show retail sales of consumer goods reached 210.8 billion yuan in May.
